title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: customers in regulated environments require strict data residency and KMS key region constraints as part of RBAC v2. This PR implements enforcement and auditability for KMS region pinning when creating or updating resources that reference customer-managed KMS keys, improves RBAC v2 policy checks to reject cross-region key bindings when a tenancy or project is pinned to a region, and adds richer audit events so security teams can track region policy violations and remediation actions. Changes include: 1) API layer validation for kms.key_region and kms.key_id fields with explicit region enforcement and clear error codes; 2) RBAC v2 policy evaluator change to incorporate resource residency metadata and explicit deny rules for cross-region bindings; 3) Audit logging additions: new audit event types (kms_region_violation, kms_region_enforced, rbac_policy_violation) and additional context fields (requesting_user, resource_region, key_region, policy_id, enforcement_result); 4) Migration script to populate existing resources with derived resource_region from their hosting zone and to backfill audit log indices for the last 90 days; 5) Admin console UX hook to surface region pinning warnings during key assignment flows; 6) Unit and integration tests that cover enforcement and audit generation; 7) Docs and release notes. Backwards compatibility: existing customers without RBAC v2 enabled see no change. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated (rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce) for 2 weeks in canary, then gradual rollout with monitoring on audit rates and error surface. Related: ENG-1984, SEC-342, SUP-7182. Checklist: - [x] API validation implemented - [x] Policy evaluator change + tests - [x] Migration/backfill script - [x] Audit schema updated and ES mappings migration included - [x] Console warning hook + docs - [x] Feature flag gating + rollout notes
